notes: Translated from OVAL's validation file refinement_instead_of_constraint2, which OVAL's SHACL validator must reject. Changed: rules named; Rule and Constraint types added; conflict and profiles declared; the payAmount refinement given a unit IRI. The refinement's place is as authored. Written as odrl:constraint on the Policy, it would still be rejected, as UnsupportedConstruct (due2-policy-constraint). OVAL keeps no result beyond the rejection.

expected_rejection.why: The Policy <http://example.com/policy:1010> carries an odrl:refinement, and the ODRL vocabulary places a refinement only on an Action, an AssetCollection, or a PartyCollection (Vocabulary §3.14.3). Normalisation rejects a constraint outside its place in stage 1 (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3), so W1 rejects the policy.

oval_expected.result: invalid: OVAL's SHACL validator must reject it
